name: Rolling Plains
summary: In southern Mulgore, herds graze the Rolling Plains while centaur raiders and harpies threaten travelers.

sections.title: Heart of Southern Mulgore
sections.body: From Bloodhoof Village, the Rolling Plains run south to the earthen gates of the Barrens. Prairie wolves, kodo herds, flatland cougars, and swift tallstriders roam these open ranges of the tauren homeland. Young hunters come here to prove their worth to the elders. They learn to track, wait patiently, and respect the land.

sections.title: Encroaching Dangers
sections.body: Mulgore’s ring of bluffs shields much of the region, but the Rolling Plains lie open to threats from beyond it. Centaur outriders have crossed the defenses here, the only frontier where they have managed to do so. They harass travelers and hunting parties. Windfury harpies roost in the eastern crags, swooping on stray game and vulnerable nomadic camps.

faq.q: What animals can be found on the Rolling Plains?
faq.answer: Wild kodo, tallstriders, prairie wolves, and flatland cougars roam the Rolling Plains. Their meat, hides, and sinew are vital to the tribes of Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Why are centaur found wandering this part of Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Rolling Plains border the eastern passes into the Barrens, making them the only region in Mulgore where centaur raiders have breached the defenses. Their outriders scout the plains, test tauren defenses, and threaten isolated hunters.

faq.q: What other hostile creatures threaten the plains?
faq.answer: Windfury harpies nest in the eastern crags, where they prey on unwary travelers and harass local wildlife. Centaur scouts also roam the plains.

faq.q: Where do the Rolling Plains begin and end?
faq.answer: The Rolling Plains stretch across southern Mulgore, from Bloodhoof Village to the mountain border beside the Barrens.

angles.text: For the newly unified tauren tribes, the Rolling Plains are vital hunting grounds. Ancient centaur enemies have come close to Bloodhoof Village, so the tribes must guard this southern corridor to survive.
As a hunter, you can track kodo, tallstriders, wolves, and cougars across the Rolling Plains. Gather provisions and tame your first animal companion here.
